title: Fake Wallet and Exchange Apps
summary: Scammers publish counterfeit wallet and exchange apps, or send links to sideload them, hoping you will enter a seed phrase or log in with real credentials.
blocks: Scammers publish counterfeit wallet and exchange apps, or send links to sideload them, hoping you will enter a seed phrase or log in with real credentials.
Some fakes look identical to the real product. Once you enter your phrase or password, the attacker has everything they need.
Install only from official app stores, check the developer name and reviews, and reach download links through the project's verified site rather than a message or ad.
